mapper.select: SELECT c.errand_order_id AS errandOrderId, c.view_count AS viewCount FROM errand_view_count c WHERE c.errand_order_id IN #{orderId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO errand_view_count (errand_order_id, view_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{delta}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_count = view_count + #{delta}, update_time = NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM errand_view_count WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM errand_view_history h WHERE h.errand_order_id = errand_view_count.errand_order_id)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO errand_view_count (errand_order_id, view_count, create_time, update_time) SELECT h.errand_order_id, COUNT(*), NOW(), NOW() FROM errand_view_history h GROUP BY h.errand_order_id ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_count = VALUES(view_count), update_time = NOW()
